title: Cannot add "Unknown" resolution to a custom format
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior I have a fallback custom format. This includes SD resolutions which I don't necessarily want, but will accept if there's no HD releases found. I am trying to add "unknown" resolution to this fallback format. Unknown is listed as an option in the dropdown when I try to add a new resolution rule. However, when I try to save the format with the new unknown resolution rule in place, I get an error that says "'Value' must not be empty." ### Expected Behavior Custom format should accept an unknown resolution rule ### Steps To Reproduce Create a custom format and try to add a rule for unknown resolution ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Win10 - Sonarr: 4.0.19.2979 - Docker Install: no - Using Reverse Proxy: no - Browser: brave - Database: Sqlite 3.36.0 ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs?
